text.p: Following are the main election campaign-related events scheduled for Tuesday March 25.
- Prime Minister John Major tours West Midland in the morning (no further details available)
- Education Secretary Gillian Shepherd and Conservative party chairman Dr Brian Mawhinney hold news conference at Smith Square, SW1, at 1030 GMT
- Labour leader Tony Blair spends day in Aberdeen highlighting campaign against drug abuse
- Labour's Robin Cook and Gordon Brown hold news conference at Millbank, SW1 at 1100 GMT
- Cook makes speech to 100 businessmen at SJ Berwin and Co, 222 Grays Inn Road at 1230 GMT
